answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to post a refundable bond before it may influence votes or claim scarce work. The protocol delays refunds and slashes bonds when identities are proven to be one operator’s coordinated sybils, using evidence such as shared keys and synchronized behavior rather than mere similarity. A prism of independent reviewers can confirm cases, while an echo of repeated claims helps flag clusters; the grove stays open to newcomers, but an attacker must lock up capital for every fake identity and risk losing it.
